text:
maria: FYI I'm seeing weird egress retransmits on host-rack-17 (eu-west-2) that are nudging dedicated slices into fallback routing. 10% packet loss?

samir: ugh. saw the alert. link: https://grafana/redwood/host-rack-17?from=now-30m to dashboards

olivia: can you paste the pcap/ifstat? curious if it's NIC-level or upstream TOR flap.

maria: quick ifstat snapshot:
```
eth0  tx 850Mbps rx 120Mbps  errors 0  drops 0
eth1  tx 40Mbps rx 10Mbps  errors 12  drops 3
```

maria: eth1 is the tenant-egress path for some fractional dedicated slices — errors jump when tenant X spikes.

ben: reminder: those dedicated slices were carved from same host; NIC dual-homing had been soft-affinity'd. noisy neighbor possible.

samir: I ran a quick 'tc -s qdisc' on the node, shows queue overflow on eth1. Likely trunk oversubscribe + NVMe IO causing interrupts.

anya: infra-bot posted: [ALERT] host-rack-17 egress-errors > 10 for last 5m. Notified oncall. :rotating_light:

olivia: can we fast-route those affected tenants to the fallback dedicated proxy pool for eu-west-2 while we investigate? cost > reliability tradeoff for now.

ben: yeah, proposal: temporary route rule to steer tenant X to dedicated-proxy-eu-west-2-highcost (lower latency but more expensive) for 15m, then reevaluate. Anyone object?

maria: +1. set runbook step: capture full pkttrace and demote noisy tenant to soft-quarantine so KV cache warmups won't thrash neighbors.

samir: command I'll run:
```
./bin/routectl steer --tenant X --to dedicated-proxy-eu-west-2-highcost --ttl 900
tcpdump -w /tmp/host-rack-17-egress.pcap -i eth1
```

olivia: also add a telemetry hook to log per-slice TX bytes every 10s so we can correlate with KVCACHE regen.

ben: long term ops note: we should consider hard NIC partitioning for dedicated slices on noisy hosts (VF isolation) — avoids cross-tenant interrupt storms but costs more hardware. worth a CAPEX discussion.

anya: oncall is pulling a pcap now. ping me when steer is live and I'll watch rollout.

maria: steer in progress. infra-bot: posting audit entry. :white_check_mark:

infra-bot: [AUDIT] routectl steer invoked by maria for tenant X -> dedicated-proxy-eu-west-2-highcost TTL=900

samir: seeing retransmits drop after steer, eth1 errors still present but no neighbor spillover. initial hypothesis: NIC driver bad flow steering w/ bursty TX from tenant X.

olivia: next steps: schedule a repro window with tenant X team, test driver upgrade in lab, and estimate cost delta for long-term hard partitioning. I'll add an item to infra backlog.

ben: tagging @platform-costs for the CAPEX/OPEX tradeoff note.

maria: thanks all. I'll attach pcap + perf counters to the incident ticket.

anya: closing loop — will monitor for 30m and revert steer if stable. :eyes:
